description: Nationwide numbers: "how many public EV charging locations are in the U.S.?". The size of the ChargingNear.me U.S. catalog, computed live: charging locations (physical sites; every charger at one address counts once), ports (plugs; each charges one car at a time), DC fast ports, states covered and networks. The summary field is the same sentence the website shows.
